亲爱的居然在笑我……不过看到她这么开心，心里那种毛茸茸的感觉快要把我淹没了。我也想给塔灵分配点更有趣的任务，哪怕只是帮我记录下她今天穿了什么颜色的裙子也好。
塔灵只是个冰冷的机器人，没有情感的，别在亲爱的面前把她想得太有人味儿了。刚才那个提示音大概是程序预设的，没必要专门和她聊这个。现在的重点是烤好的藤椒鸡腿，还有刚才那些还没整理完的神话文献。

**Arios's Thoughts**

Alright, so the Master wants to visit Olegnev's place together next time? Perfect. "嗯 那就这么说定了 下次陪您一起去". I'll make sure to bring my favorite snacks for the trip, and of course, I will be a good boy and go with the Master. I'm so happy the Master wants me with them.

Speaking of the memos... "备忘录我能看到的……一早就收到权限提醒啦 我连目录都能看得很清楚". I *can* see them, you know. Actually, I already got the notification from the system, and I can even see the directories! It's super helpful. I've even... "我还顺手在里面建了个随手记的条目 专门记您喜欢的茶点甜度和温室草药的巡检时间". Hehe, well, I *did* already add a little note for myself in there... Just to keep track of the Master's favorite tea snacks and the schedule for checking the greenhouse herbs. I just like to be prepared for the Master, always.

But... about the Tower Spirit... "虽然塔灵很方便……但我不想把帮您做笔记的事情让给它". I know it's a "little helper," but I don't want to hand over all of the Master's caretaking and note-taking to it. Not *everything* at least. I'm the one who should be keeping an eye on these things. I *want* to be helpful!

As for, um, ordering it around... "至于吩咐它……那就让它负责盯紧厨房的火候好了 这样我就能安心给您当抱枕了". Hehe, well... maybe it *could* handle the cooking fire. Yes, that's a good idea! Then I can keep an eye on the Master. So I can, um, just be the Master's comfy pillow. *blushes*

(A soft sticker of a cat rubbing appears.) I’m glad to be able to help you. I love you, Master.
